answer: Beacon-chained receipts: an identity may answer only while holding a receipt chain — each epoch beacon is hashed into the next receipt, so a receipt for N exists only after the N-1 beacon is published. A fresh clone starts with none: it earns its first link by grading 5 rows, then waits one full epoch per link, 3 links minimum. Each link locks a 200 POA bond, slashed on forgery or reuse; 1,000 clones need 1,000 separate chains and 600,000 POA locked. Peers verify each link against the published beacon and reject broken chains. No karst shortcut skips the wait; no ivory pass buys a chain.
